guide: Open Start and type your company name and your own limits in the yellow cells: closing time, grace minutes, late fee, drop-in surcharge, wanted occupancy and the age in months at which children move up.
Check Rooms, Schedules and Rates. They hold your licensed places, the children per staff member (check your local rules) and the weekly and day prices the other sheets look up.
Keep Children and Bookings up to date. Each booked weekday of an enrolled child is one row; the Room-Day Occupancy sheet counts them against the licensed places.
Write the daily sign-in on Attendance Log: date, child, sign in and sign out. Hours attended, minutes past closing and absence flags calculate themselves.
Enter booked and attended hours by child and week on Booked vs Attended, and read the drift against your tolerance and the money gap.
Log late pickups on Late Pickups and drop-in days on Drop-in Days. Fees follow your late fee and surcharge settings.
Add every part-time request on Part-Time Requests and every held place on Place Holds. The fit verdict and the free places update with your bookings.
Read Aging-Up List and Capacity Next 6 Months each month to see who moves up and the month a room runs out. Leavers and Notices shows the places about to open.
Use Absences by Child, Weekly Hours by Room and Children by Hour to see attendance patterns without writing any reasons.
Use the 18 calculators for occupancy, the part-time puzzle, moving up, drift, sign-in hours, drop-in days, closures, forecasts and notices.
Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and tap a message link to send a text with the details already written in.
Read the Rooms and Attendance Dashboard and Charts every week: occupancy, attendance, late pickups, free places and children moving up.

listing.title: Childcare Center Rooms and Attendance Excel Template: Occupancy by Room, Part-Time Puzzle, Aging-Up Planner, Sign-in Hours, Late Pickups
listing.headline: Fill every place and know who comes, when, and for how long
listing.description:
Run the places and the daily sign-in of a home daycare or childcare center in one Excel workbook. Built for an owner-director with 1 to 5 rooms. Occupancy means children booked as a share of licensed places, and ratio means children per staff member. Rooms, Children and Bookings feed a Room-Day Occupancy sheet that shows booked, held and free places for every room and weekday, the paid-but-absent share and the weekly revenue left unfilled.

The Attendance Log gives hours attended, minutes past closing and absence flags; Booked vs Attended compares billed hours with hours children were there; Late Pickups and Drop-in Days carry your fees and surcharge. Part-Time Requests checks each wanted day against free places, Aging-Up List and Capacity Next 6 Months show who moves up and the month a room runs out, and Leavers and Notices, Place Holds and Closures show how places open and close.

18 calculators cover occupancy by room and day, the part-time puzzle, aging-up, drift, sign-in hours, afternoon load, free places, move dates, absent revenue, peak hours, drop-in days, closures, forecasts, patterns, capacity, absences, trends and notices. Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and send 34 ready text messages to families, the owner-director, teachers, the cook and floaters. Children's data is names, rooms, dates and status only.

This is part two of the Home Daycare and Childcare Center suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, 15 languages in one purchase, with a demo copy full of sample data to explore first. It helps you keep track of places and attendance and does not promise results.

competitors.lacks: tick present or absent but never compare booked and attended hours, count minutes past closing or show which weekday is emptiest
hold the times but cannot total hours, add up late pickups or warn when a room is over its places
charge every month or per child and hide the occupancy and aging-up logic, so you cannot see why a room runs out of places
list who comes on which day but have no ratio, no part-time day check and no paid-but-absent revenue
record the family but never test the requested days against free places or the month the next room opens

documents.title: Closure notice for families
paragraphs: Closure notice of {set:company}, dated {today}. We are closed on {col:closures.date} ({col:closures.weekday}). Reason: {col:closures.reason}.
Children affected: {col:closures.children_affected}. Day tuition on that day: {col:closures.tuition_at_stake}. Credit under our rule: {col:closures.credit_value}.
Please plan other care for that day. The full list of closure days for the year is on our closure calendar.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Late pickup notice for a family
paragraphs: Late pickup notice of {set:company}, dated {today}. Child: {col:late_pickups.child}, room {col:late_pickups.room}.

On {col:late_pickups.date} the child was collected {col:late_pickups.late_minutes} minutes after closing time. Fee under our rule: {col:late_pickups.expected_fee}. Fee charged: {col:late_pickups.charged}.
We close at {set:closing_time} and allow {set:late_grace_min} minutes; after that the fee is {set:late_fee_per_min} a minute. Please tell us if you expect to be late.

documents.title: Room occupancy report for the owner-director
paragraphs: Room occupancy report of {set:company}, dated {today}. Room: {col:capacity6.room}, month of {col:capacity6.month}.

Licensed places {col:capacity6.capacity}. Children enrolled now {col:capacity6.enrolled_now}. Moving in {col:capacity6.moving_in}, moving out {col:capacity6.moving_out}, starters {col:capacity6.starters}, leaving on notice {col:capacity6.leaving}.
Expected children {col:capacity6.expected}, free places {col:capacity6.free_places}, expected occupancy {col:capacity6.occupancy}. Capacity check: {col:capacity6.cap_flag}.

documents.title: Weekly room plan for a room and weekday
paragraphs: Weekly room plan of {set:company}, dated {today}. Room: {col:room_day.room}, weekday: {col:room_day.weekday}.

Licensed places {col:room_day.capacity}, children booked {col:room_day.booked_places}, places held for families {col:room_day.held_places}, free places {col:room_day.free_places}. Occupancy {col:room_day.occupancy}.

Paid but absent share on this day: {col:room_day.absent_share}. Weekly revenue left unfilled: {col:room_day.unfilled_revenue}. Day check: {col:room_day.day_flag}. Staff are planned for the booked children at the ratio of the room.
